Initial release of AI Video Drama, a cinematic video enhancement tool.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB) and apply AI-driven dramatic enhancements.
- Processes raw video clips into cinematic drama content in about 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Supports adding dramatic music, color grading, text overlays, and rendering to 1080p MP4 for easy sharing.
- Seamlessly handles authentication and session management, including automatic token retrieval for new users.
- Provides clear error handling, session state feedback, and status updates during processing and exports.
- Designed for filmmakers, content creators, and social media storytellers seeking fast, professional-quality drama video edits.
